content:
Yesterday, Apple announced a price increase for Apple Music and two Apple One bundle plans.

Apple currently offers a wide range of services, from Apple TV to Apple Music, Apple Fitness+, and more. Apple One allows you to bundle these services together at a lower price.

Is Apple One worth it? Here's what you need to know.

Apple's Services

Here's a quick recap of the services Apple currently offers:

  • Apple Music: Apple's music streaming service, with access to over 100 million songs. $11.99 per month
  • Apple TV: Where you can watch hit shows and movies like "Ted Lasso," "Severance," and "Pluribus." $12.99 per month
  • Apple Fitness+: Apple's digital fitness platform, offering video workouts across 12 different exercise types. $9.99 per month
  • Apple Arcade: A gaming subscription service with over 200 games, all free of in-app purchases and ads. $6.99 per month
  • Apple News+: Access top news reports, publications, daily puzzles, in-depth recipes, and more. $12.99 per month
  • iCloud+: Includes iCloud storage, Apple Invites, iCloud Private Relay, Hide My Email, custom email domains, and HomeKit Secure Video. $0.99/month (50GB), $2.99/month (200GB), $9.99/month (2TB)

Apple One Bundles

Apple offers three different tiers of Apple One: Individual, Family, and Premier, bundling up to six Apple subscription services together for a single price.

Apple One Individual (Save $13/month)

  • Apple TV
  • Apple Music
  • Apple Arcade
  • iCloud+ with 50GB of storage

Total if subscribed separately: $32.96

Apple One Individual price: $19.95

Apple One Family (Save $15/month)

Share the following services with up to five family members:

  • Apple TV
  • Apple Music
  • Apple Arcade
  • iCloud+ with 200GB of storage

Total if subscribed separately: $42.96

Apple One Family price: $27.95

Apple One Premier (Save $33/month)

  • Apple TV
  • Apple Music
  • Apple Arcade
  • Apple Fitness+
  • Apple News+
  • iCloud+ with 2TB of storage

Total if subscribed separately: $72.94

Apple One Premier price: $39.95

Is Apple One Right for You?

This question mainly depends on which Apple services you find useful, but you also need to do the math.

For example, if you're already subscribed to Apple TV and Apple Music, you should definitely switch to Apple One Individual. Not only will you save on your Apple Music and Apple TV subscription fees, but you'll also unlock more iCloud storage and features, as well as Apple Arcade.

Additionally, Apple recently raised the price of Apple Music. Interestingly, while the top two Apple One tiers have become more expensive to accommodate the price hike, Apple One Individual has not, making it an even better value than before.

I recommend reviewing the bundle options and individual service prices above, and doing the math for yourself and your family. I dare say that many readers reading this article should be able to save some money by switching to an Apple One plan. Alternatively, you may have been thinking about subscribing to a new service, and the Apple One discount might make that decision easier.

The value of Apple TV continues to grow as well. It has already added free F1 and MLS live streaming this year. If you've been on the fence about subscribing to Apple TV, Apple One might make it easier to justify that extra subscription cost.

Are you an Apple One subscriber? If so, which services do you use most? Feel free to share with us in the comments below.
